description_en: Queries the status of a single file in a file gateway's file share
description_zh: 查询文件网关某个共享下单个文件的状态
kebab_example: aliyun sgw describe-gateway-file-status --gateway-id gw-0004wacp5e4ll15420000 --index-id NFSalex-gx-nfs-12010000 --file-path sub/cptestfile0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeGatewayFileStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file share. You can call the DescribeGatewayFileShares operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享ID。可以通过DescribeGatewayFileShares接口获得
parameters.name: index_id

Code.description_en: The status code. A status code of 200 indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。状态码为200表示请求成功

Message.description_en: The description of the request result

Status.description_en:
The status of the file in the file share of the file gateway. The following values are returned:

Not found: The file path does not exist.
Clean: The file is synchronized.
Waiting to upload: The file is waiting to be uploaded.
Uploading: The file is being uploaded.
Waiting to download: The file is waiting to be downloaded.
Downloading: The file is being downloaded.
Unknown status: The file status is unknown. We recommend that you retry the request
Status.description_zh:
查询文件网关某个共享下某个文件的状态，返回值如下：
Not found：文件路径不存在。
Clean:文件已同步。
Waiting to upload：文件待上传。
Uploading：文件上传中。
Waiting to download：文件待下载。
Downloading：文件下载中。
Unknown status：文件状态未知, 建议重试

Success.description_en:
The result of the request. The following values are returned:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求结果。返回值如下：
true：请求成功。                                
false：请求失败
